svg.title: Use case diagram - Restaurant Rush (final design, tag stage-3)

g.text: Use case diagram - Restaurant Rush (final design, tag stage-3)
An actor is a role: a marker replaying a script plays the
Manager role; only the source of the commands changes.
The Cashier, arrivals and abandonment run automatically inside every turn,
so they are use cases the turn includes, not actors.
Every staff task (Host, Waiter, Chef) can also be Wait.
Brief 3.2: status = 3.1, staff tasks = step 2, automatic steps = steps 1, 3-5,
During Happy Hour, waiting customers recover 15 at turn start (automatic).
Prices are locked when the order is taken (VIP first, then Happy Hour).
